_about: Card summaries for eval agents (P2). 'cards' are hand-written for every agent a case places in the roster (correct answers, confusers, and messy-roster decoys). They are written as natural status notes, not copies of the user's question, and decoys share their topic's words but describe different or finished work, so the model has to read what each agent actually did. 'distractor_summaries' give each generated padding agent a short, finished status line by naming pattern (one variant chosen per name, deterministically). Kept separate from cases.json and world.json so roster names, and the committed baselines, are unchanged.
